description: Get full details of a specific QR code by its ID. Use this when the user wants to inspect a particular QR code's configuration, check its destination URL, view its design settings, or see its current status. Returns all metadata including content, destination, design, scan limits, and timestamps.

id.description: The unique identifier of the QR code. Obtain this from quality_qr_list or quality_qr_create responses.

name: quality_qr_get
